title: Figure 49: real acoustic pressure contours at 10,000 Hz, radiating sphere
description: ANSYS 12.1 nodal-solution contour plot of the real component of pressure (Pa) for 10,000 Hz with 25 elements per wavelength in water. Dense concentric rings confined near the source corner; legend -4062 to 7068 Pa. Highest-frequency case in the BAASS radiating-sphere underwater acoustics series.
